description: This file contains an abstract test class for unit testing Android Fragments using Robolectric, including a nested static class for a specific activity setup.

classes.name: RobolectricFragmentTestCase
classes.description: An abstract base class for Robolectric-based unit tests targeting Fragments within an activity, providing utility methods for fragment retrieval and activity control.

classes.name: TestMainSettingsActivity
classes.description: A static inner class extending MainSettingsActivity, used to set up navigation state during tests.

methods.name: getStartFragmentNavigationId
methods.description: Abstract method to be implemented by subclasses to specify the starting fragment's navigation ID.

methods.name: getCurrentFragment
methods.description: Returns the current fragment from the activity being tested.

methods.name: getCurrentFragmentFromActivity
methods.description: Static method to retrieve the current fragment from a given FragmentActivity.

methods.name: createActivityController
methods.description: Creates and returns an ActivityController for the test activity, setting the initial fragment.

methods.name: onPostCreate
methods.description: Overrides the activity's post-creation method to set up navigation to a specific fragment.
